notes:
- **(Admin) Refresh library metadata on demand.** In Settings, under
  "Server & health", a "Refresh now" button fills in any missing episode
  titles, descriptions and thumbnails without waiting for the nightly pass.
- **(Admin) Low-storage warning.** When the server's disk gets close to full
  (85%), the admin sees a red alert across the top of the app — with "Don't
  show again" to silence it, or close it just for this session.
